title: Chili-ghetti
description: This chili-ghetti recipe is akin to chili-mac but with spaghetti plus ground beef, tomatoes, kidney beans, mushrooms, chili seasoning mix, and cheese.
ingredients: 1 (15.5 ounce) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 (4 ounce) can mushroom stems and pieces, drained

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes; drain.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, onion, and garlic; cook and stir until beef browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Stir spaghetti, kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, mushrooms, water, chili seasoning, and Parmesan cheese into beef mixture until combined. Cover the skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until hot, about 10 minutes. Top with Cheddar cheese.
